parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~27584~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the forwarding rule.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb describe-rule-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rule-id rule-bp1efemp90000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
